title: Plan the coursework project
description: Break the coursework requirements into manageable milestones.

title: Set up the React and TypeScript app
description: Create the Vite project and install the required dependencies.

title: Design the task data model
description: Define the fields and TypeScript type used by each task.

title: Build the task list page
description: Display tasks with their due dates, priorities and completion states.

title: Add task search and filters
description: Allow tasks to be searched and filtered by status and priority.

title: Implement task creation form
description: Add controlled inputs and inline validation for new tasks.

title: Implement task editing
description: Pre-fill the form with the selected task before saving changes.

title: Add delete confirmation
description: Ask for confirmation before permanently removing a task from the current session.

title: Test task workflows
description: Write component tests for rendering, validation and task actions.

title: Check the mobile layout
description: Verify the application at a viewport width of approximately 375 pixels.
